verdict.rationale: Unity ships a comprehensive scripting API, editor extensibility (custom inspectors/windows), asset database API, headless/batchmode command-line flags, build automation, and now both an in-editor MCP server and a standalone CLI with `unity eval`/`unity <command>` that 'drive the Editor directly without MCP,' giving strong programmatic parity with UI workflows. However there's no explicit documentation claiming full UI-API parity, and some AI features are metered/closed (Unity Credits, no public MCP repo), so some capability gaps likely remain unaddressed. Missing for 10: explicit parity documentation/spec, independent verification that all UI-only actions are scriptable, and open (non-metered) access to AI-driven API paths.
